<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/navigation.ts -->
<!--
  A vertical navigation: the brand at the top, the links stacked, the user at the bottom. Axes: width (full:
  icon and name, compact: icons only with the name hidden), user (show, hide), density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";

  export type SidebarNavProps = {
    label: string;
    brand: string;
    links: NavLink[];
    current?: string;
    userName: string;
    userEmail: string;
    width?: "full" | "compact";
    user?: "show" | "hide";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    label,
    brand,
    links,
    current = "",
    userName,
    userEmail,
    width = "full",
    user = "show",
    density = "default",
  }: SidebarNavProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="aside"
  class={cn(
    "flex min-h-96 flex-col gap-6 rounded bg-card p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border",
    (((width as string) === "compact") ? "w-20 items-center" : "w-64")
  )}
  aria-label={brand}
  data-testid="sidebar"
  data-width={width}
>
  <Group gap="2" align="center">
    <LucideIcon name="layers" size={24} />
    <Text size="base" weight="bold" class={(((width as string) === "compact") ? "sr-only" : "")}>
      {brand}
    </Text>
  </Group>
  <Block tag="nav" class="flex-1" aria-label={label}>
    <List
      class={cn(
        "m-0 flex list-none flex-col p-0",
        (((density as string) === "compact") ? "gap-0" : "gap-2")
      )}
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each links as l (l.id)}
        <ListItem>
          <Link
            href="#/"
            variant="default"
            aria-current={((l.id === current) ? "page" : undefined)}
            class={cn(
              "flex items-center gap-4 rounded px-4 text-sm",
              "py-2",
              ((l.id === current) ? "bg-muted font-semibold" : "")
            )}
            data-testid="item"
          >
            <LucideIcon name={l.icon} size={16} />
            <Inline class={(((width as string) === "compact") ? "sr-only" : "")}>
              {l.name}
            </Inline>
          </Link>
        </ListItem>
      {/each}
    </List>
  </Block>
  {#if ((user as string) === "show")}
    <Group gap="4" align="center" class="border-t border-border pt-4" data-testid="user">
      <MediaFrame alt={userName} ratio="1/1" class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
      <Stack gap="0" class={(((width as string) === "compact") ? "sr-only" : "min-w-0")}>
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {userName}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {userEmail}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
  {/if}
</Block>
